glossary.definition: A Japanese residence status for work in designated fields. Check the official field guidance for skills, Japanese-language requirements and any applicable exemptions.
A Japanese programme combining work and technical training. Confirm the current framework, eligibility and any transition arrangements through official guidance before considering a placement.
A commonly used description for professional work-related residence categories in Japan. The exact status and permitted activities must be confirmed for the role.

A residence and work route for eligible highly qualified workers in participating EU countries. Conditions are set by the relevant country; it is not unrestricted permission to work throughout Europe.
An employment route for eligible qualified workers. Check the particular German route, qualification requirements and job offer rather than relying only on this general label.
An assessment of how a foreign qualification relates to local requirements. Whether it is needed, and who performs it, depends on the profession and employment route.
A Saudi residence document. Confirm the employer’s responsibilities and applicable work and residence permissions for the individual case.
Terms often used in UAE employment discussions. Check the current official process for the job offer, contract, entry or residence and permission to work.
A UAE policy concerning employment of UAE nationals. Employers should check the current rules that apply to their establishment with the relevant authority.
A Polish national visa category. For work, check the official work-related document requirements; it is not a general authorisation to work anywhere in the EU.
An Israeli work-visa category. Confirm the prior approval and occupation-specific procedure; caregiving has a separate process from the general consular guidance.
An arrangement in which a separate entity is the legal employer under applicable local rules. This definition does not establish that GlobalPath offers an EOR service.
A contractual provision for replacement support, if agreed. Eligibility, exclusions, duration and responsibilities must be stated in the actual service agreement.
A recruitment principle under which the employer bears recruitment fees and related costs. Ask for a clear written fee allocation; this definition is not a statement of an unverified company policy.
